The Sold To (AWG / UNFI) could not be identified for this consolidation, so the Consolidation Request was not sent in order to avoid mislabeling it.

Flow ID: @{outputs('Compose_FlowId_From_Body')}
Marker in the ride-with email: @{if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('AWG_-_CON_-_03_Compose_Customer_Raw'),''))),'(empty)',outputs('AWG_-_CON_-_03_Compose_Customer_Raw'))}
Customer column in tracking: @{if(empty(trim(coalesce(first(body('AWG_-_CON_-_03_Filter_Tracking_Item'))?['Customer'],''))),'(empty)',first(body('AWG_-_CON_-_03_Filter_Tracking_Item'))?['Customer'])}
Original subject: @{coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/subject'],'')}
POs: @{join(outputs('All_POs'), ', ')}

Please review it manually and send the Consolidation Request with the correct customer.
